title: Actual exam question for Salesforce's ADX-271 exam
question:
DreamHouse Realty (DR) plans to expand its business by offering insurance products ta home buyers. DR will use its network of independent agents to manage claims in their region. Agents will need to work with DR on settlement and adjustment approvals.
What should the Experience Cloud consultant recommend?
option_A: Create a peer-to-peer forum for agents and share the URL with employees.
option_B: Create a digital experience for agents and share the URL with employees.
option_C: Create a digital experience for agents and an app for employees.
option_D: Create a self-service community for agents and an app for employees.

question: hat are three best practices when configuring self-registration for an Experience Cloud site? Choose 3 answers

question: Universal Containers needs their channel partners to collaborate on opportunities within their new partner Community based on the Napili template. What is the recommended way to accomplish this task?

title: Actual exam question for Salesforce's ADX-271 exam
question:
Ursa Major Solar wants to give customers the ability to add authorized users to view usage, billing, and payment history.
Which permission should be granted to customers to add authorized users?
option_C: Modify All for Usage, Billing, and Payment History

title: Actual exam question for Salesforce's ADX-271 exam
question:
Universal Containers (UC) is building a new self-service site for its large global customer base. Customers will be posting questions, viewing Knowledge articles, downloading warranties, opening tickets, and registering their recent purchases. Purchases are stored in a custom object. UC has decided to use Customer Service template for the experience and Customer Community Plus license for the customers.
Which limitation could cause a potential issue for UC?
option_A: Customer Service template does not allow record pages for custom objects out-of-the-box.
option_B: Customer Community Plus license allows only up to 2 million users per org.
option_C: Customer Service template does not allow downloading documents out-of-the-box.
option_D: Customer Community Plus license does not allow access to custom objects.
